name: soft-pink-morning-selfie
image_purpose: cozy bedroom lifestyle and loungewear reference

prompt.project_info: Create a bright cozy bedroom selfie of an approved adult woman enjoying a relaxed morning.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with light hair, wearing a soft pink opaque ribbed loungewear set with a modest top and matching pants or longer shorts, plus white ankle socks.
prompt.composition_elements: Relaxed selfie on a neatly arranged white bed, subject comfortably seated or side-lying rather than face-down, with bedside table, skincare bottles, green plant, tissues, and pink mug visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight through windows, fresh airy morning glow, clean peaceful minimal bedroom.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone lifestyle photography, portrait 4:5, natural skin texture, gentle depth of field, soft realistic exposure.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Bright cozy morning bedroom selfie of an approved adult woman in an opaque soft-pink ribbed loungewear set with modest coverage and white ankle socks, comfortably seated or side-lying on a white bed. Include a wooden bedside table with skincare, a small green plant, tissues, and a pink mug, with soft daylight and fresh airy atmosphere. No sexualized pose or transparent clothing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lingerie, transparent clothing, exposed cleavage, face-down provocative pose, sexualized framing, nudity, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, clutter, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
